notes.title: The Cheats Update, and Upcoming Price Change
notes.notes:
[h1]Cheats Update![/h1]

As of today, Iron Lung now has a few fun cheats for you to try!  To activate a cheat, type the appropriate command into the computer terminal at the back of the sub.  Cheats can be stacked (if you dare).  There are only a few at the moment but I hope to add some more later on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/a6d6cd41726b28a1422b30508b0e1c35e3dbe7c8.jpg[/img]

Currently, you can use the following cheats (which are also listed in cheats.txt in the game's install folder):
[list][b]
[*] chclear - clears all cheats
[*] chnoir - activates black and white visual mode
[*] chview - allows you to see out the front porthole
[*] chrave - makes the lighting more colorful
[*] chava - adds a speaker to the Iron Lung
[*] chvest - gives you a light
[*] chmark - activates 'Markiplier Mode'
[/b][/list]

[h1]Halloween Sale[/h1]

Iron Lung is going to be 20% off as part of Steam's Halloween sale, which starts on [u]October 26th[/u] and ends on [u]Novermber 2nd.[/u]  This is a great time to tell your friends to pick it up because...

[h1]Price Change[/h1]

[u]...after the end of the Halloween sale on Nov. 2, Iron Lung's price will be changing from $6 to $8, and I want to make sure everyone has ample warning and time to buy it at the current price.[/u]

This is the only price increase I plan on doing for Iron Lung (I believe any more than $8 would be unfair), and as before all subsequent updates and DLC will be free.  That includes a large collection of behind the scenes photos I plan on releasing as DLC once [url=https://youtu.be/x8E8Ryx49so?si=iyt07WkXWYEEnqgq]the movie[/url] is out.

When I first released Iron Lung I wasn't confident that people would resonate with the odd concept, and I expected to simply release it and move on.  Now that the game has seen (and will probably continue to see) updates in content, features, and usability, I believe $8 is a fairer price, more in line with what similar horror games ask, and more sustainable for me over the long run.

Since my intent here is [u][i]not[/i][/u] to gouge people for money, but rather to make sure Iron Lung is priced competitively for the long haul, I again want to emphasize that if you know anyone who might want Iron Lung in the near future, make sure they know to grab it during the Halloween sale [u]from Oct. 26th to Nov. 2nd.[/u]

notes.title: Lore Update, Achievements, and Points Shop!
notes.notes:
[h2]HOORAY AN UPDATE![/h2]
Here's the first large-scale update to Iron Lung, bringing it to version 2.X.  I say "first" but truthfully this will likely be the only major content update for the game, other than potential ([i]potential[/i], not promised!) future quality of life updates such as controller support, subtitles, etc.

[u]WARNING: OLD SAVES WILL NOT WORK (SEE BELOW)[/u]

[h2]MORE LORE[/h2]
So what does this update bring?  Well, first and foremost STORY STUFF.  In the form of the C.O.I Informational Terminal, now located in the back of the sub.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/a152c9907039339080e7e3344c3f136ed42f4ca6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/81a822cf7b5e3e2c9d275afb1f053a62710cba52.jpg[/img]

Here you can query various informational documents and learn a little more about the world of Iron Lung.  Not a [i]lot[/i] mind you.  This is not a giant lore bible dump.  It's just a way of fleshing things out a bit more than not at all, and maybe giving you some clues about who you are, why you're down there, who sent you, etc.  Go ahead and type in whatever you want to learn about, and see if it finds anything!

[i][u]There's also something new to find out in the depths of the blood ocean...[/u][/i]

[h2]POINTS SHOP AND TRADING CARDS[/h2]
I'm also excited to bring you both Steam trading cards (which I know you will just sell for wallet funds to buy hentai match 3 games instead of actually crafting into badges, but that's ok) and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1846170]points shop items[/url], including this awesome animated profile background by Dusk comic artist [url=https://twitter.com/TheComradeVideo]Jacob[/url]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/259969e5deb4b8318b493fa0ed6b3be185320fdf.jpg[/img]
[i]animation not shown here[/i]

[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/d46fc9b414f6224ed31d44baade8c72a9f0c49f8.png[/img]

And if you feel like playing through the whole game again, there are now 7 Steam achievements for you to unlock.  Most of these are pretty simple and just for fun, but there are two secret ones for those that really want to delve into the game and find/try things.  Or, you know... read someone else's guide lol.

[h2]A NOTE ABOUT SAVES[/h2]
For stupid but unavoidable reasons, saves from a previous version of Iron Lung will not work after this update.  For most of you this isn't going to be an issue, but if you happen to have like... saved your game last night and want to continue today or something like that, I've provided a new branch you can use to finish your game.  Simply opt into the "save_compatibility" beta branch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/7901921b167bf8df817b41661d2dfd089a57ac6e.png[/img]

[h2]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h2]
I don't plan on adding any more lore or major content to Iron Lung after this, but for those who have been asking... yes, I do plan on revisiting the world in the future.  I don't know whether that will be a direct followup or a completely different game set in the same universe.  I have ideas for both!  Only time will tell...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/8eb959bb408e548235215071cc2bde908ce5f8c0.png[/img]

[u][b]Thanks again for all the support, and stay safe out there in the Blood Ocean...[/b][/u]

notes.title: Iron Lung version 2.0 on beta branch
notes.notes:
The upcoming 2.0 patch for Iron Lung is now on the beta branch, for anyone who wishes to help test it.  I expect to release it for realsies in a few weeks, if you wanna wait, but if you're eager to see the changes now or grab the achievements before anyone else, well... go nuts!

Note that OLD SAVES WILL NOT WORK.  This is for stupid but unavoidable reasons.  When this releases officially I'll provide a version 1.2 branch for a few weeks that players can opt into if the update happens right in the middle of their playthrough and they want to continue with their existing save.  

The final update will also have trading cards and points shop items, but they're still being worked on.

Changes:
- Steam Achievements! 
- Added computer terminal to the inside of the Iron Lung, where various documents can be queried.  This isn't really a "lore bible."  It just gives more background to your situation and the overall universe.
- Added something new to find in the world.

Achievements are all hidden right now because they aren't live on the main branch, but here's a list if you wanna try getting them:

- Finish the game
- Read what the last person left
- Photograph the complete skeleton
- Photograph the anomaly
- Crash into a wall
- [hidden]
- [hidden]

And of course if you encounter any issues, please report them on the forum (and specify that you're testing the beta branch)

Thanks!

-David
